title: Preschool open doors; procurement exemption.
bodyText: Effective July 1, 2020, any expenditure of funds by the department to implement, operate, or expand the preschool open doors program may be made without regard to chapters 103D and 103F.
bodyHtml: [§346-185]  Preschool open doors; procurement exemption.  Effective July 1, 2020, any expenditure of funds by the department to implement, operate, or expand the preschool open doors program may be made without regard to chapters 103D and 103F. [L 2020, c 46, pt of §7]
